location_fine: roadside pull-off on an empty country highway
key_props: cardboard sign propped on the car
visual_synopsis: A white Soviet-era sedan is parked on the shoulder of a bleak winter highway with a blank board propped against it; a grey-haired man in a grey jacket and striped scarf leans into the window haggling with the dark-haired woman inside, and a DVD player with its remote is shown in close-up as the goods. A dark SUV pulls up, two heavy-set men in a black jacket and a beanie get out, lean menacingly into the car window and work over the seated couple for the rest of the sketch before driving off.
